messages.subject: Davis R Users' Group (D-RUG) meeting tomorrow! Learn about web scraping and text processing in R
messages.subject_clean: Davis R Users' Group (D-RUG) meeting tomorrow! Learn about web scraping and text processing in R
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

This is your weekly reminder of tomorrow's R Users Group work group. As usual, we'll be meeting from 10-noon on Wednesdays.

This week, we will begin with a mini-workshop by Liza Wood to show us how to use R for web scraping and text processing. Following that, we will have a work group for the remainder of the time. This is when we will split up and help each other work through problems in our R jouRneys.

We will be meeting in a hybrid format, via zoom <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/92807937862>, and in the Data Lab classroom (360 Shields Library). If you're attending virtually, please post your questions to the discourse site ahead of time. Info + links below.

Best,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

________________________________________________________________
Please remember to post your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website <https://d-rug.github.io/> for more information.

We are also seeking presenters! It is nice to mix things up with occasional presentations. In the past, we've had (15- to 45-minute) presentations ranging from data types, to tidyverse tools, to spatial data, to the Google Earth Engine plugin for R. If you would like to hone your teaching, need an excuse to perfect your cRaft, or want to show off a cool R trick you learned, shoot us an email and we can add your presentation to our calendar (see below)! Presentations can be in-person or virtual (and in-person presentations will be streamed for virtual attendees).

Current presentation schedule:
Sept 28: Brief intro to function writing and iteration (Liza)
Oct 5: Creating a package (Liza)
Oct 12: Paper discussion (Wes)
Oct 19: Visualize data changing over time using for loops and the Magick package (Jesse)
Oct 26: Writing unit tests and integrating with Github's build tools (Wesley)
Nov 2:  Intro to web scraping and text processing with regular expressions (Liza)
Nov 9:
Nov 16: Shiny Apps (Tara)
Nov 23: -- Thanksgiving week --
Nov 30: Paper discussion (Wes)
Dec 7: --  Finals week --

--
Check out our R resources at https://d-rug.github.io/
And please post questions/comments at https://d-rug.discourse.group/
---
